title: project — capability bindings for this project
description: Use when a project needs its capability bindings written or refreshed — onboarding, adding a capability, or changing which tool satisfies one. Agents are authored against capability names (backlog, memory, code-intel), never tool names; this skill's `setup` playbook writes the `## Capabilities` table into the project's AGENTS.md (and CLAUDE.md where it is not a symlink), binding each capability to the concrete tool that satisfies it here plus the lazily-loaded usage skill that documents its verbs. The same agent body then runs unedited here (backlog = this repo's tool) and in a project where the capability is Jira. Enforces the two absence semantics: an absent row means the capability is unavailable (surface and stop; never substitute or invent — tool-starvation b5670d03); a row with an empty tool means it does not apply here (proceed; ADR-0017). Agent bodies never name a tool; this section is the binding.
author: sox
